newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong police seize 30,000 Ecstasy tablets.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong police seize 30,000 Ecstasy tablets.

text.p: Hong Kong police said on Thursday narcotics officers had seized 30,000 tablets of Ecstasy, the largest quantity of the drug ever found in the British territory.

Narcotics Bureau officers arrested four men for trafficking in dangerous drugs after the seizure in the bustling district of Tsim Sha Tsui on the Kowloon Peninsula on Wednesday afternoon, police said in a statement.
Police said the tablets, which were imported from the Netherlands, had a street value of HK$9 million ($1.16 million).
Ecstasy is a synthetic stimulant popular on the dance club scene.
